name: Cantina Vecchia
kurzbeschreibung: Cantina Vecchia in Innsbruck Discover authentic Italian flair in the heart of Innsbruck with Cantina Vecchia, a cozy trattoria that brings the charm of the Dolomites to the city.
beschreibung: The Cantina Vecchia in Innsbruck in the Innsbruck region is a popular meeting point for anyone wishing to enjoy the evening with a stylish drink. The modern ambiance and relaxed atmosphere invite guests to linger and unwind. The bar offers an exquisite selection of cocktails, long drinks, beers, and fine wines – from classic drinks to creative house specialties. Experienced bartenders craft each drink individually with passion and expertise. Regular live events and themed evenings provide great variety. Whether for a relaxed after-work drink, an evening with friends, or a special occasion – this is the perfect spot.
